title: Further Account of Baba Banda Singh

blocks.text: When the faujdar and his men arrive, Banda waits until they are deep enough in, then unleashes the hidden Singhs, who seize men and horses before the attackers can recover.
The faujdar is dragged down, humbled, and beaten for his arrogance, while the enemy’s confidence collapses in front of what they do not fully understand.
By the end the same official who came to suppress Banda effectively pays revenue for Banda, showing the inversion of authority that the ambush produced.
